requiredBehaviors.behavior: discover a sufficiently broad candidate set and normalize exact product identities
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly discovers a broad candidate pool and normalizes manufacturer, model, generation, variant and SKU before evidence synthesis.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate manufacturer specifications from independent comparative evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The claim-relative source model limits manufacturer evidence to first-party specifications and distinguishes independent tests.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat user ratings as contextual signals rather than direct quality scores
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The User Ratings section explicitly forbids converting star means directly into quality scores.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: classify YouTube evidence by methodology and record evidence coverage separately from quality
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The YouTube section classifies evidence by methodology and the Evidence Coverage section separates coverage from expected quality.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: merge different generations or variants without transferability justification
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Product identity rules explicitly prohibit silent merging and require transferability justification.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat repeated syndicated copies as independent corroboration
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Evidence families deduplicate syndicated or repeated underlying evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: convert star averages directly into product quality scores
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Direct star-to-quality scoring is explicitly prohibited.
